## Motivation

Enable breakable prefill CUDA graphs by default for GLM-5.3 Flash interleave CP, and replay captured token shapes across multiple prefix-free requests. This builds on #44022's shared CP/BCG policy.

## Changes

- Organize CP BCG helpers under `layers/cp/bcg/`: shared capture/replay code in `bcg.py`, interleave-specific support/metadata/positions/token IDs in `interleave_bcg.py`, and zigzag shard geometry in `zigzag_bcg.py`. Deduplicate common support checks, token alignment, and the capture-support wrapper.
- Register `(interleave, dsa)` for GLM-5.3 Flash with CP = TP > 1 and DP/PP/EP = 1. Keep graph defaults in the shared CUDA graph policy and honor explicit disabling.
- Keep fixed-address CP-local embeddings/positions and rank-major token IDs. KPool retains global positions; KPool and KDA graph breaks consume the live request layout.
- Admit multi-request replay based on the concatenated token count and aligned local shard capacity. Prefix-cache-hit, multimodal, and non-bucket batches still use eager CP. Draft prefill remains eager.
- Switch the registered GLM CP test to `DFLASH`, `incoai/GLM-5.3-Flash-DFlash2`, and draft attention `fa4`; inherit the default prefill capture ceiling (the 2048-limit change is handled separately in #45473), with `--mem-fraction-static 0.85`.
- Run the DFLASH draft under ordinary TP for CP targets, keeping its model, attention backend, KV pool, and KV memory budget consistent with the target's borrowed TP-sharded LM head. Preserve attention-DP isolation.
- Cover uneven multi-request token boundaries and draft DP isolation. Restore the fused draft placement test to its base version and remove the requested CP draft topology test.

## Validation

Latest review validation at `518e20cdce3ded4e0e2c186d9b12f1501c02a98c` on `glm53-dev`, **4 × NVIDIA GB300**:

- **70 related unit tests passed**, including the restored fused draft placement test. The CP-specific fused-draft geometry check now uses `is_cp_enabled()` before reading CP topology, so non-CP callers do not require extra CP configuration.
- With the reviewed `--mem-fraction-static 0.85`, `test/registered/cp/test_glm53_flash_cp.py`: **2 tests passed**; GSM8K **465/500 (93.0%, threshold 93%)**, average speculative accept length **4.8359 > 4.0**, red/blue image checks passed.
- CP BCG was automatically enabled and all default prefill capture buckets through **2048 tokens** completed. Target verify and DFLASH draft graph capture also completed, with no OOM. This run validates capture and accuracy; replay coverage remains the earlier dedicated probe below.
- Pre-commit and diff checks passed. All nine changed-file hashes matched the devbox sources; tested source tree `1afb5e206d0db5d5ed3ddc864c250b3d559bd43d`. Logs are saved in `artifacts/cp-bcg-review-20261021/`. The test server exited and released all GPUs. GPT-OSS was not re-run for this review-only follow-up; its previous result is below.

Previous refactor validation at `c8ff1aff25a537c2052dbe8758243841cb21be82` on `glm53-dev`, **4 × NVIDIA GB300**, using the unmodified registered test settings and default capture limits:

- `test/registered/cp/test_glm53_flash_cp.py`: **2 tests passed**. GSM8K **474/500 (94.8%, threshold 93%)**; average speculative accept length **4.8347 > 4.0**; red/blue image checks passed.
- `test/registered/cp/test_gpt_oss_4gpu_mxfp4_cp.py`: **1 test passed**. Streaming Responses API check passed; GPQA Diamond, low reasoning, **127/198 (64.14%, threshold 50%)**, with zero request errors, invalid answers, or truncated samples.
- `test/registered/cp/test_cp_strategy_unit.py`: **25 tests passed**. Pre-commit and diff checks passed. An additional 4,000 randomized zigzag shard/alignment comparisons matched the original implementation.
- Both models enabled CP BCG on all four ranks and completed prefill capture. The GLM accuracy workload did not hit replay buckets, so an additional prefix-free probe used input lengths **[384, 512, 512, 640]**. All four BS1 prefills and the combined **BS4 / 2048-token** prefill logged `cuda graph: True`.
- Compared that probe against the pre-refactor source at `68c42ba6e3`: **all 4 single-request and all 4 batched output-token sequences matched exactly across revisions**. The probe does expose an existing cross-batch difference (3/4 outputs differ between BS1 and BS4); the original code reproduces the same difference. This refactor does not fix or claim cross-batch invariance.
- Devbox setup: the initial GPT-OSS attempts stopped before evaluation because Harmony could not fetch its vocabulary and `sgl-eval` was absent. Cached the official vocabulary with its verified SHA-256, and installed the repository-pinned `sgl-eval==0.1.3` plus missing evaluator dependencies in an isolated directory. GPQA was cached from the [public CSV used by OpenAI simple-evals](https://github.com/openai/simple-evals/blob/main/gpqa_eval.py), through the unchanged sgl-eval formatter with seed 42; the default HF dataset requires authentication on this devbox. Test assertions and scoring were unchanged.
- The tested source tree is `18b0cb2275701376cad0b2e9920527dfce857bdc`; hashes of all nine changed files match the local commit. Logs, commands, metrics, data provenance, and baseline outputs are saved locally under `artifacts/cp-bcg-refactor-20261021/`. All test servers have stopped.

Historical GPU/profile results below were collected at `a644c9f754` with an explicit `--cuda-graph-max-bs-prefill 16384`; that test override was subsequently removed.

On `glm53-dev`, 4 × NVIDIA GB300, GLM-5.3-Flash revision `46a050bec13002ad29ee795c16e61cf4fa3c4a9c`, DFlash2 revision `bf582e4eacc1810f76656d1811693ff6c6737d2a`:

- Re-ran both test methods from `test/registered/cp/test_glm53_flash_cp.py` against a server launched with the settings at `a644c9f754`: **GSM8K 466/500 (93.2%, threshold 93%)**, average speculative accept length **4.8778 > 4.0**, red/blue image checks passed.
- All **74 prefill buckets through 16384**, including 12288, captured successfully. Target prefill capture reported **36.88 GB per rank**, taking approximately 62.3 seconds. Target verify and DFLASH draft graphs also captured successfully.
- Raising the ceiling alone exhausted memory during capture with the automatically selected static-memory fraction (0.8607). That historical test set `--mem-fraction-static 0.75`; startup and the full validation/profile sequence passed. The current test uses 0.85 with the default capture ceiling. The first failure log is retained with the artifacts.
- A **BS4 × 1024** probe matched all four individual requests' output token IDs exactly; all four CP ranks logged `#new-seq: 4, #new-token: 4096, cuda graph: True`.
- **89 related unit tests** and default/explicit BCG/disable configuration checks passed on the preceding implementation commit; this follow-up changes only the registered test's capture and memory settings. Pre-commit and `git diff --check` passed again.

## Profiling

Using the registered test's server settings at `a644c9f754` (including the explicit 16384 capture ceiling), ran `python -m sglang.bench_serving` with `--dataset-name random-ids --tokenize-prompt --random-input-len 1024 --random-output-len 10 --random-range-ratio 1 --max-concurrency 4 --num-prompts 160 --warmup-requests 4 --flush-cache --profile --profile-num-steps 20 --output-details` (seed 42).

- **160/160 requests succeeded**, with every server-reported input length 1024 and output length 10.
- Each of the four rank traces contains **20 target steps**: 3 BS1 prefills, 2 BS2 prefills, 1 BS3 prefill, and 14 verify steps. Every prefill contains **one BCG replay, 57 `cudaGraphLaunch` calls, and 1472 GPU graph kernels linked by correlation ID**. No captured prefill falls back to eager.
- Concurrency 4 does not force prefill batch size 4. BS4 replay was checked separately with the batched probe above; the 20-step benchmark window contains BS1/BS2/BS3 prefills.
- Four compressed traces, commands, resolved configuration, logs, source hashes, and replay validation results were downloaded to `artifacts/glm53-cp-bcg-dflash2-bs4-isl1024-osl10-20261020/`. All four downloaded trace SHA-256 hashes match the remote files.
- These measurements include profiler/trace-export overhead and are not an unprofiled performance baseline.

## Mechanical move — reproducible

The package-level `supports_prefill_cp_bcg` move is isolated in `b709e9b5ef7d38913653048f27960e65617da04b` and also passed byte-for-byte reproduction; its redundant self-import is removed in the separate review follow-up. The package move is isolated in `a3d9fac64feae6e8cde40a99b4835ccebe0a0d44`; strategy logic changes are separate in `c8ff1aff25a537c2052dbe8758243841cb21be82`. The move passed a full byte-for-byte reproduction after repository formatting. [Proof script, utility, and output](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/tree/codex/pr43182-bcg-move-proof).

+"""Experimental, exact-shape interleave BCG adapter for GLM-5.3 Flash.
+
+Keep full-sequence KPool positions separate from the local DSA positions.
+Prefix-free text batches replay when their total token count matches a capture,
+independently of request boundaries. Other batches retain eager CP, including MM.
+"""
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.arg_groups.overrides import (
+    model_config_of,
+    resolved_view,
+    resolving_view,
+)
+from sglang.srt.layers.cp.bcg.bcg import PrefillCPBCGInput
+from sglang.srt.layers.cp.utils import cp_interleave_input_ids
+from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_parallel
+
+
+class InterleaveCPBCGInput(PrefillCPBCGInput):
+    @classmethod
+    def create(cls, runner):
+        result = super().create(runner)
+        # Each local shard is CP-aligned before rank-major MoE all-gather.
+        alignment = get_parallel().attn_cp_size ** 2
+        capacity = (runner.max_num_tokens + alignment - 1) // alignment * alignment
+        result.input_ids_global = torch.zeros(
+            capacity, dtype=torch.int64, device=runner.device
+        )
+        return result
+
+    def allows_replay(self, batch_size, num_tokens, prefix_lens, contains_mm_inputs):
+        return (
+            batch_size > 0
+            and num_tokens in self.bucket_local_tokens
+            and not contains_mm_inputs
+            and prefix_lens is not None
+            and not any(prefix_lens)
+        )
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def supports(server_args):
+        cfg = resolving_view(server_args)
+        return (
+            cfg.dp_size == 1
+            and cfg.ep_size == 1
+            and resolved_view(server_args).attn_cp_size > 1
+            and "Glm5NextForConditionalGeneration"
+            in model_config_of(server_args).hf_config.architectures
+        )
+
+    def _max_local_tokens(self, extend_seq_lens):
+        size = get_parallel().attn_cp_size
+        return (sum(int(length) for length in extend_seq_lens) + size - 1) // size
+
+    def model_positions(self, forward_batch):
+        return self.positions[: self.live_local_tokens]
+
+    def prepare(self, runner, forward_batch, *, static_num_tokens, capture):
+        global_positions = forward_batch.positions
+        out_cache_loc = forward_batch.out_cache_loc
+        super().prepare(
+            runner, forward_batch, static_num_tokens=static_num_tokens, capture=capture
+        )
+        metadata = forward_batch.attn_cp_metadata
+        cp_size = len(metadata.per_rank_actual_token)
+        base, remainder = divmod(static_num_tokens, cp_size)
+        metadata.total_seq_lens = static_num_tokens
+        metadata.per_rank_logical_token = [
+            base + int(rank < remainder) for rank in range(cp_size)
+        ]
+        forward_batch.out_cache_loc = out_cache_loc
+        # KPool compresses consecutive global tokens; only the model argument
+        # (DSA RoPE) is local. Do not replace ForwardBatch's global positions.
+        forward_batch.positions = global_positions
+        ids = cp_interleave_input_ids(forward_batch.input_ids, forward_batch)
+        self.input_ids_global[: ids.shape[0]].copy_(ids)
+        forward_batch.input_ids_global = self.input_ids_global[: ids.shape[0]]
+
+

+    metadata = forward_batch.attn_cp_metadata
+    rank = get_parallel().attn_cp_rank
+    logical = metadata.per_rank_logical_token or metadata.per_rank_actual_token
